title: Beaded Flowers
venue: Digital Constellations, Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity
summary: A field of beaded flowers to walk through. Beadwork by Robyn Adams, modelled in 3D by Quinn Hopkins.
description: Beaded Flowers is a collaboration with Robyn Adams. Robyn beads the flowers. I model them in 3D, bead by bead, and prepare them as game assets for the worlds she builds in Unreal Engine.
We started working together at the Banff Centre during the Digital Constellations residency.

Here the flowers grow as a field. Walk the bead path through it, or open Each flower to see the eight plants one at a time: asters, coneflowers, wild rice, blueberry, prairie crocus, wolf willow, table flowers and a flat spray.
howTo: Drag to look around. Tap or click the ground to walk there, or use the arrow keys or WASD.
Press Each flower to see one plant at a time. Drag to turn it. Previous, Next and the row of names change the flower.
Press Field to go back to the meadow.
Motion turns the wind and the drifting lights off and on.
embedNote: Drag to look and tap the ground to walk. Each flower shows them one at a time.

coverAlt: A hazy meadow made entirely of glass beads: pink asters, yellow coneflowers and blue berries among strands of green bead grass, with points of light drifting over it.
